theme: Last day ashore before the charter.
greeting: You're in Dubrovnik with the Nautilus charter boarding this afternoon, Dan. The girls are with Jen in Florida, so today is yours to close out the trip logistics while you still have a steady signal.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers
needsAttention.detail: Three dry-land pieces for Sept 19 still open in Todoist: the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and a pre-dawn checkout for the 7:30 flight. All need arranging before charter connectivity drops.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with the instructor
needsAttention.detail: The Nautilus boarding time and location, plus the Sept 19 return transfer to the airport, still need confirming in Todoist. Worth nailing down before you're aboard and offline.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20 to Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV at TPA is now a firm booking, not a hedge, since the Pathfinder is being driven down. Marked p1 and overdue in Todoist; do it while you have wifi.

schedule.title: Board the Nautilus charter
schedule.detail: Dubrovnik marina; a week on the water begins

flagged.title: Chase card statement ready
flagged.detail: Statement balance $217.84, due Oct 8, auto-pay already on. No action needed beyond a glance.

flagged.title: Talkiatry bill is ready
flagged.detail: A bill for Aug 18 care is ready to pay whenever you have a moment.

flagged.title: ICGN policy newsletter landed
flagged.detail: The governance policy roundup for early September is in your inbox, close to your field.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, receipts, and promos: butternut squash recipes, iPhone 18 pre-orders, and chocolate at Fashion Week.

recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in.

tasks.title: Book St Pete landing-gap stay (Sept 20 to 22)

acts.line: A quiet last morning in Dubrovnik for provisioning ashore: cash, snacks, and any dietary items before the shops are behind you.
The window to sort dry-land logistics: confirm boarding with the instructor and lock the Cavtat transfers while you still have signal.
Board the charter around 5, and expect connectivity to thin out from here through the sailing week.
